description:
## Question

Is defk ready to publish 0.1.0? This is the last ticket of the map 'Wayfinder: defk ready for a first Hex release'. The map ends here: the publish itself (mix hex.publish) is not part of it.

Check and do:
- version 0.1.0 in mix.exs; the first-release notes in mix.exs (for example the Defk.Errors footer base)
- CHANGELOG.md with the 0.1.0 entry
- zero open [BUG] tickets
- one green run of the full CI matrix on the release commit, from either CI path, cited
- the stability promise guide merged; the Linux run recorded; the triage's blockers closed
- mix hex.build passes and the package holds what a dependent needs
- the verdict's Limitations line names what was and was not checked

Done when: every item holds, and the resolution comment cites the evidence.

comments.text:
Resolution: defk is ready to publish 0.1.0. Release commit 984f09c (main, pushed).
Evidence:
- Version 0.1.0 in mix.exs. The compile error footer links the installed version's HexDocs page (https://hexdocs.pm/defk/0.1.0/compile-errors.html#<code>). README, getting-started, measuring, deploying and scope.md describe the Hex release ({:defk, "~> 0.1"}).
- CHANGELOG.md has the 0.1.0 entry and the renames table.
- Zero open bug tickets (bw list --type bug --status open: none).
- Full CI matrix green on the release commit, native GitHub runners: run 38689612139 on 984f09c, linux-x86_64-clang, linux-x86_64-gcc, linux-aarch64-clang, macos-arm64-clang all success.
- The stability promise guide is merged (defk-wfi.4); the Linux run is recorded (docs/performance.md 6.31, defk-a1p); the triage's blockers are closed (defk-djy.19, defk-wfi.12).
- mix hex.build passes in CI ('Building defk 0.1.0'). The package holds lib, priv/defk_runtime.h, mix.exs, README, LICENSE, CHANGELOG, CONTEXT and the user docs; a scratch project against the unpacked package compiled and ran a kernel (42), put its library in the app's ebin, and printed the HexDocs footer.
- docs/verdict.md Limitations name what was and was not checked on Linux.
Also done while checking, at the maintainer's direction: the published pages link no development docs (performance.md, project.md, verdict.md, beam-nifs.md, fast-path-report.md, research, bench, ci) and no ticket ids; no ticket ids in code, tests or scripts (160 files; a test enforces it); the known-failure doc marker takes a reason. Fixed on the way: the podman fallback's x86-64 image build under Rosetta (ERL_FLAGS as a build arg); adaptive_slice_test asserts the extra yields (summed >= 10 over five pairs) instead of a time model that shared runners broke. One Rosetta-only failure (magnitude(-0.0, 0) gave 0.0 once) did not reproduce and native runners pass; ci/README.md records it.
Not part of this map: mix hex.publish, and the v0.1.0 git tag (docs source_ref is v0.1.0).

title: Release-readiness check for 0.1.0
